podcast.body: Recorded on November 20, 1969, this song features an eight-bar drum break played by Clyde Stubblefield. At James Brown's insistence, the rest of the band stops playing, allowing Stubblefield's groove to continue, creating a distinct and highly influential rhythmic section. This break has since been sampled and looped in at least 1,700 different songs. "On November 20th, 1969, the band recorded a song called Funky Drummer."

podcast.body: James Brown's 1970 song "Funky Drummer" features a drum break by Clyde Stubblefield that has been sampled in nearly 2,000 other songs. This specific drum beat became a highly influential and frequently used sample in various musical genres. "That's James Brown's drummer Clyde Stubbelfield from a 1970 song called Funky Drummer."
